name: com.getquario/mcp
title: quario
description: Validate and render quario report definitions (JSON) to PDF, Excel, Word, HTML or CSV.

environmentVariables.name: QUARIO_LICENSE
environmentVariables.description: The license key. Leave it unset to evaluate, and the output carries a watermark.

environmentVariables.name: QUARIO_DATA_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: The directory a dataPath resolves in. Defaults to CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR when set.

environmentVariables.name: QUARIO_OUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: The directory rendered files are written to. Defaults to quario-mcp under the system temp dir.

environmentVariables.name: QUARIO_LOCALE
environmentVariables.description: The default locale for numbers and dates.

environmentVariables.name: QUARIO_CURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: The default currency, as an ISO 4217 code such as EUR.

environmentVariables.name: QUARIO_TIME_ZONE
environmentVariables.description: The default time zone for dates.
